name: speaks
description: Reads Claude's replies aloud with Pocket TTS (local CPU), cleaning up paths, numbers and jargon for speech.

http_url.title: TTS server URL
http_url.description: An OpenAI-style /v1/audio/speech endpoint, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8880/v1/audio/speech for Kokoro-FastAPI. Empty: Pocket TTS only. Pocket also speaks whenever a request fails. ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} are expanded here and in every http_* option.

http_api_key.title: TTS server API key
http_api_key.description: Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. A literal key, or ${ENV_VAR} to read it from the environment at request time. Leave empty for a local server.

http_model.title: Model
http_model.description: The request's model field, e.g. kokoro or tts-1.

http_voice.title: Voice
http_voice.description: The request's voice field, e.g. af_heart.

http_sample_rate.title: Sample rate
http_sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the server's pcm output, in Hz.

http_timeout.title: Request timeout
http_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the server before falling back to Pocket TTS.

http_extra.title: Extra request fields
http_extra.description: JSON merged into the request body, e.g. {"speed": 1.1, "normalization_options": {"normalize": false}} for Kokoro-FastAPI.

replacements.title: Replacements
replacements.description: Every word-level fix, applied first and the same for every engine; one 'find => replace' per entry. A plain word matches whole words (any case if written lowercase); /regex/ is a pattern. Pre-filled with light rules that suit Kokoro; add your own, e.g. 'kubectl => cube control' or 'py => pie'.

speak_hashes.title: Read hashes
speak_hashes.description: Commit hashes and UUIDs read as "hash ending with" plus their last four characters.

speak_paths.title: Read file paths
speak_paths.description: Slashes, dots, dashes and underscores inside paths and file names read aloud: a/b.py -> "a slash b dot py".

speak_snake_case.title: Read snake_case
speak_snake_case.description: Underscores in names read aloud: debug_log_text -> "debug underscore log underscore text". Vowelless parts are spelled out.

speak_versions.title: Read versions
speak_versions.description: v0.3.2 -> "vee zero point three point two".

speak_numbers.title: Read numbers
speak_numbers.description: Numbers, units, multipliers and negatives as words: 8 GB, -5 dB, 2x, 1,234.

spell_letter_digits.title: Spell letter+number
spell_letter_digits.description: p99, x86 -> "pee 99", "ex 86". Useful for Pocket TTS.

spell_abbreviations.title: Spell abbreviations
spell_abbreviations.description: Vowelless words (db, cfg, RTX) and all-caps ones like TTY are spelled letter by letter. Useful for Pocket TTS; add a replacement for any you want said as a word, e.g. "St => street".

pocket_voice.title: Pocket TTS voice
pocket_voice.description: Built-in Pocket voice: eponine, azelma, eve, jane, vera, jean, marius, … (alba is male).

volume_db.title: Volume boost (dB)
volume_db.description: Gain through a soft limiter. 0 is unchanged; 6 is a good start.

max_chars.title: Spoken length limit
max_chars.description: Characters spoken per reply before '… and more on screen'. 0 means no limit.

audio_backend.title: Audio output
audio_backend.description: auto: paplay where it exists (Linux/WSL with PulseAudio or PipeWire), otherwise sounddevice (PortAudio: bundled on macOS; on Linux install libportaudio2).

http_split_sentences.title: Send sentence by sentence
http_split_sentences.description: One request per sentence, fetched ahead of playback: the first audio comes after one sentence, not the whole reply.

debug_log_text.title: Log spoken text
debug_log_text.description: Write the exact text each engine is given to ~/.local/state/claude-speaks/daemon.log (readable only by you), for troubleshooting pronunciation.
